name: Footer — editorial statement
description:
Inverted footer that reads like a manifesto: small brand line, a huge two-style statement (italic lead + bold uppercase display), a short paragraph, large uppercase nav links with ↗ arrows, an optional featured card (lg+ only) and a legal strip with the studio credit. The statement is a

; an sr-only h2 names the landmark. Gentle fadeIn + stagger entrance.

contentSlots.brand: small brand line above the statement
contentSlots.statementLead: first half of the statement (italic, light)
contentSlots.featured: card: label? + image {src, alt} + title + href + linkLabel? (lg+ only)
contentSlots.credit: studio credit { label, href } — defaults to DigitalForms
